reader.notes: The series lowers to one engine Initiate() per name in written order, confirmed in the generated C#. The SR1 refusal's message cites only §2023 at --std 85, which belongs to SR1, not this rule.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-152/rini4.cob (--std 85): three reports, two on one file (FD REPORTS ARE R1 R2), counters moved by page advances (R1 LC 02 PC 04, R2 LC 02 PC 03, R3 LC 03 PC 05) and MOVE 41/43 into named sum counters; one INITIATE R2 R3 R1 printed R1 00 01 00 R2 00 01 R3 00 01 00, each initialized as by its own INITIATE.
